name: sit up
description: The classic sit up, curling your torso from the floor to upright. It builds strength in the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips by your head.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Avoid yanking on your neck; lead with your chest.
